Jesse

source.subject: Your Sonarcloud device (PA System) is down - Troubleshooting
source.body:
Hello!


We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (PA System) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.


Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't receive announcements either.


If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.


If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.


Thank you and have a fantastic day!



You have received this e-mail because we are monitoring your Sonarcloud device. If you would like us to stop monitoring your Sonarcloud device, simply reply to this e-mail and let us know.

source.subject: Your Sonarcloud device (PS 208 PA System) is down - Troubleshooting
source.body:
Hello!


We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (PS 208 PA System) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.


Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't receive announcements either.


If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.


If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.


Thank you and have a fantastic day!



You have received this e-mail because we are monitoring your Sonarcloud device. If you would like us to stop monitoring your Sonarcloud device, simply reply to this e-mail and let us know.

source.subject: The Founders Are Back: A New Era for SonarCloud, Exciting Partnerships, and Commitment to Our Valued Customers.
source.body:
Dear SonarCloud family,

We hope this message finds you well. We are thrilled to announce that SonarCloud's original visionaries, Jesse Baptiste and Michael Leonetti, are back at the helm of the company. After a successful stint with our previous venture, we have returned, more experienced and more passionate than ever, to our original mission: transforming the school bell system and making school announcements more engaging.

First and foremost, we want to express our heartfelt appreciation to each of you. We understand that transitions can be challenging, and some of you may have experienced frustrations during our absence. We want to assure you that our renewed involvement in SonarCloud means a renewed commitment to our customers. We're back to ensure that your voices are heard, your needs are met, and that we continue to improve our service based on your feedback.

Now, for the big news: SonarCloud has partnered with Spotify! This landmark partnership will allow us to provide a fully licensed music library, offering schools a wide variety of music choices for their transitions and announcements. With this collaboration, we are giving a legal and exciting musical upgrade to the traditional school bell system.

We couldn't be more thrilled about this partnership with Spotify, a global leader in the music industry. This means that your school can now tap into a world of music, ensuring that transitions are not just routine, but engaging moments of the day that stimulate creativity and promote a positive learning environment.

As we take the reins of SonarCloud, our promise to you is to continually push the boundaries of what a school bell system can be. We're passionate about creating positive change within our educational communities, and we believe that by integrating music into the school day in a whole new way, we're taking a major step toward that goal.

Thank you for being part of our SonarCloud family. Your support and feedback have been instrumental in bringing us to where we are today. We can't wait to embark on this exciting new journey together, creating schools that resonate with the sounds of progress, engagement, and joy.

With renewed energy and commitment,

Jesse Baptiste and Michael Leonetti Co-founders, SonarCloud

source.subject: Announcing the Swift Student Challenge 2025
source.body:
Announcing the
Swift Student Challenge
2025

We’re thrilled to announce the Swift Student Challenge 2025. The Challenge provides the next generation of student developers the opportunity to showcase their creativity and coding skills by building app playgrounds with Swift.

We’ll select 350 Swift Student Challenge winners whose submissions demonstrate excellence in innovation, creativity, social impact, or inclusivity. From this esteemed group, we’ll name 50 Distinguished Winners whose work is truly exceptional and invite them to join us at Apple in Cupertino for three incredible days where they’ll gain invaluable insights from Apple experts and engineers, connect with their peers, and enjoy a host of unforgettable experiences.

All Challenge winners will receive one year of membership in the Apple Developer Program, a special gift from Apple, and more.

Applications will open in February 2025 for three weeks.

We’ve created free Swift Coding Club resources so students can start clubs and work with peers who are passionate about app creation. Swift Coding Clubs use the new Develop in Swift Tutorials so students can learn the foundations of app development with Swift and beyond.

source.subject: Your Sonarcloud device (PA System) is down - Troubleshooting
source.body:
Hello!


We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (PA System) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.


Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't receive announcements either.


If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.


If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.


Thank you and have a fantastic day!



You have received this e-mail because we are monitoring your Sonarcloud device. If you would like us to stop monitoring your Sonarcloud device, simply reply to this e-mail and let us know.

source.subject: Your Sonarcloud device (PS 163 PA System) is down - Troubleshooting
source.body:
Hello!


We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (PS 163 PA System) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.


Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't receive announcements either.


If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.


If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.


Thank you and have a fantastic day!



You have received this e-mail because we are monitoring your Sonarcloud device. If you would like us to stop monitoring your Sonarcloud device, simply reply to this e-mail and let us know.

source.subject: Heartfelt Thanks for Your Support During Black History Month & Exciting Transition to Women's History Month
source.body:
Hi Janet,

As we close the chapter on an inspiring Black History Month, I want to extend a profound thank you for your unwavering support and the positive feedback that has illuminated our journey. Your encouragement has been instrumental in making this month's programming both impactful and memorable for our community.

As we pivot to another significant observance, I'm thrilled to announce that Women's History Month will commence on March 4th. This upcoming month is dedicated to celebrating the remarkable achievements and contributions of women throughout history. We aim to continue the momentum of engagement and inspiration, bringing to light the stories of pioneering women who've paved the way for progress and equality.

Among the incredible women we will highlight are:

  • Marie Curie, the trailblazing physicist and chemist known for her work on radioactivity.
  • Rosa Parks, whose act of defiance became a pivotal moment in the civil rights movement.
  • Amelia Earhart, the adventurous aviator who dared to dream beyond the horizons.
  • Malala Yousafzai, the youngest Nobel Prize laureate, advocating for girls' education worldwide.
  • Frida Kahlo, a pioneering artist, channeled her pain and passion into vibrant paintings that revolutionized how we perceive art, identity, and resilience.

These stories, along with many others, will serve as a beacon of courage, resilience, and innovation. We look forward to exploring the diverse and dynamic contributions of women across various fields and eras.

Thank you once again for your support during Black History Month. Let's carry forward this spirit of celebration and learning into Women's History Month, honoring the legacy and influence of women in shaping our world.

Warmest regards,

Sonarcloud Team

source.body:
Hello!


We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (Millenium Art PA System) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.


Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't receive announcements either.


If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.


If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.


Thank you and have a fantastic day!

source.subject: Your Sonarcloud device (PA System) is down - Troubleshooting
source.body:
Hello!


We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (PA System) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.


Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't receive announcements either.


If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.


If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.


Thank you and have a fantastic day!



You have received this e-mail because we are monitoring your Sonarcloud device. If you would like us to stop monitoring your Sonarcloud device, simply reply to this e-mail and let us know.

source.subject: Your Sonarcloud device (East Harlem Scholars HS PA) is down - Troubleshooting
source.body:
Hello!


We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (East Harlem Scholars HS PA) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.


Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't receive announcements either.


If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.


If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.


Thank you and have a fantastic day!



You have received this e-mail because we are monitoring your Sonarcloud device. If you would like us to stop monitoring your Sonarcloud device, simply reply to this e-mail and let us know.

Hi Marjorie,

We hope your school year is off to a fantastic start! As we continue to evolve Sonarcloud, we're thrilled to share some exciting updates that have been implemented based on your valuable feedback.

New Video-to-Audio Bell Feature

You can now easily add a video URL to the audio you'd like to use as a bell, right within the Sonarcloud platform. The system will automatically extract the audio for you. For a step-by-step guide on how to utilize this feature, please visit our Medium article here.

Soothing Bell Tones from Headspace

To further enrich your school's auditory experience, we've added a selection of soothing tones from Headspace to our bell options. These tones are perfect for setting a calm and focused atmosphere, whether it's to start the day or transition into the afternoon. Look out for new tones like "Aura Tone," "Happy Day," "Ping 1," "Ping 2," "Soft Chime," and "Fresh Start," among others

Bug Fixes and Android App Release

We've resolved the issue where updating the audio of multiple bells was causing an error. Additionally, our new Android app is now available for download in the Google Play Store.

We're committed to continually improving Sonarcloud to make your learning environment not just efficient, but also engaging and stress-free. Thank you for your ongoing support and feedback; it's invaluable to us.

For any questions or further assistance, our dedicated support team is always here to help.

Best regards, The Sonarcloud Team

P.S. Stay tuned for more updates on our integration feature, coming soon!

We look forward to continuing this journey with you to create the best possible learning environment for your school community.

source.subject: Are Your School Bells Amplifying Anxiety?
source.body:
Hi Drysdale,

I hope this message finds you well. Over the past few months, we've engaged in extensive research and fieldwork across various educational institutions. An observation, perhaps overlooked by many, came to the forefront - the profound impact of traditional school bells on students and staff.

For many students and educators, the shrill tone of a conventional bell isn't just a signal to transition from one activity to another. It can be an unexpected jolt, a trigger of stress, or even a subtle amplifier of anxiety. Such frequent daily disturbances can take a toll, especially when we understand the importance of maintaining a calm and conducive learning environment.

This led us to develop a solution addressing this very concern. At SonarCloud, we've designed a system to replace these abrupt, anxiety-inducing bells with customizable, soothing, and more harmonious sounds. Our goal? To promote a more serene school atmosphere, where transitions are smooth and the environment remains conducive to learning and teaching.

I'd love the opportunity to discuss how we could assist your school in making this transition. A small change in auditory cues can bring about a noticeable positive shift in daily school life, benefitting both students and staff.

If this resonates with you, I'd be more than happy to set up a short presentation or demonstration. Let's work together to ensure our school environments are as nurturing and stress-free as possible.

Looking forward to your thoughts and please get in touch here.

Warm regards,

Jesse B.

source.subject: Are Your School Bells Amplifying Anxiety?
source.body:
Hi Administrator,

I hope this message finds you well. Over the past few months, we've engaged in extensive research and fieldwork across various educational institutions. An observation, perhaps overlooked by many, came to the forefront - the profound impact of traditional school bells on students and staff.

For many students and educators, the shrill tone of a conventional bell isn't just a signal to transition from one activity to another. It can be an unexpected jolt, a trigger of stress, or even a subtle amplifier of anxiety. Such frequent daily disturbances can take a toll, especially when we understand the importance of maintaining a calm and conducive learning environment.

This led us to develop a solution addressing this very concern. At SonarCloud, we've designed a system to replace these abrupt, anxiety-inducing bells with customizable, soothing, and more harmonious sounds. Our goal? To promote a more serene school atmosphere, where transitions are smooth and the environment remains conducive to learning and teaching.

I'd love the opportunity to discuss how we could assist your school in making this transition. A small change in auditory cues can bring about a noticeable positive shift in daily school life, benefitting both students and staff.

If this resonates with you, I'd be more than happy to set up a short presentation or demonstration. Let's work together to ensure our school environments are as nurturing and stress-free as possible.

Looking forward to your thoughts and please get in touch here.

Warm regards,

Jesse B.

www.getsonarcloud.com

source.subject: To All School Administrators: A Heartfelt Welcome to the New School Year!
source.body:
Hi Linton,

An Eagerly Awaited Fresh Start

Here we are at the start of a new academic year, and the anticipation in the air is electric. With every fresh beginning, the promise of untapped potential and new possibilities lingers all around us. To the principals, vice-principals, administrative staff, and every role in between, we extend our most heartfelt wishes for an extraordinary year ahead!

The Multifaceted Role You Play

You're not just "the administration." You're the visionaries setting the mood and the mission for your educational communities. You work tirelessly behind the scenes, creating a space where educators can teach and students can learn, often with little fanfare. It's a role deserving of applause, and we salute you for the difference you make every single day.

Tackling Challenges with Grace

Certainly, the year ahead will present challenges. From changes in curriculum standards to advancements in edtech—like our very own Sonarcloud system—to the complex task of creating a secure and nurturing environment for all, the road won’t be free of obstacles. Yet, if anyone is poised to face these challenges with resilience and creativity, it's you. Each hurdle is but another opportunity to showcase your leadership and dedication.

The Exciting Journey Ahead

This new academic year is your blank canvas, ready to be filled with vibrant colors of innovation, emotional stories of student triumphs, and milestones of unprecedented success. Whether you're adopting new tech solutions or experimenting with various teaching methodologies, the sky's the limit.

We’ve Got Your Back

Remember, your journey is one of shared commitment. Teachers, parents, and the community at large—yes, including us here at Sonarcloud—are all part of your extended support system. If you ever need quick guidance, our comprehensive help guides are just a click away: Quick Tips and Refreshers.

Cheers to You!

So here's our toast to you, the true heroes of our educational system. May your year be punctuated by moments that make you proud, challenges that make you stronger, and little victories that make every day worthwhile.

Wishing you a wonderful first day back and an inspiring year to come!

Sincerely,

Sonarcloud Team

source.subject: Best Practices for Mental Health & Success: A Guide for Administrators in the New School Year
source.body:
Hi Barbara,

The dawn of a new school year brings excitement, challenges, and opportunities. As administrators, you’re in a unique position to shape the mental landscape of your institution. Drawing upon insights and our experience at Sonarcloud, here are some strategies to ensure success and well-being.

1. Embrace Brain Health:

The brain is central to all we do. Recognizing the importance of mental well-being isn’t just essential; it’s transformative. Keep in mind that “Your wellness and peace are a priority; everything else is secondary.”

2. Acknowledge and Grow:

While the past holds valuable lessons, it’s essential to cultivate an environment of positivity and forward momentum. Remember, “Our past is a lesson, not a life sentence.”

3. Invest in Self-care:

Taking time for self-care isn’t selfish. It’s the fuel that drives success. Be it meditation, reading, or exercise — make it a priority.

4. Open Dialogues Foster Growth:

Encourage open conversations about mental health. Destigmatize discussions, and know that “Being vulnerable is the first step towards freedom.”

5. Seek Continuous Learning:

The realm of mental health is expansive. Stay informed. Attend workshops, join webinars, and imbibe knowledge that ensures the well-being of your educational community.

6. Work-Life Harmony Over Balance:

Life isn’t always about balance; it’s about harmony. Encourage teachers and students alike to find that harmonious blend in their academic and personal lives.

7. Nutrition is Key:

Diet impacts our mental health in profound ways. Promote brain-boosting foods and encourage conscious living and mindful consumption.

8. Incorporate Mindfulness:

Consider practices like yoga and meditation. Simple techniques can drastically reduce stress and increase focus.

9. Stay Vigilant and Supportive:

Being observant can make all the difference. If someone seems to be struggling, approach them with empathy and provide the necessary support.

10. Celebrate Every Victory:

Regardless of size, every success is a testament to perseverance. Celebrate it. Feel gratitude, as it truly is the healthiest of all human emotions.

To wrap it up, this school year, let’s embrace holistic wellness, drawing from age-old wisdom and modern insights. At Sonarcloud, we’re with you every step of the way, ensuring a harmonious blend of academic success and mental well-being.

All the best of luck this year!!

source.subject: A Fresh Start: Elevating the New School Year with Sonarcloud!
source.body:
Hi Patrick,

I hope this message finds you well as we stand on the threshold of another exciting academic year. The dawn of a new school term always brings with it an air of anticipation, especially for dedicated leaders like you, who are at the helm of crafting transformative experiences for students and staff.

Sounding the Bells of Change:

Gone are the days of the jarring, anxiety-inducing school bells. At Sonarcloud, we're passionate about reimagining school transitions with a focus on mental well-being. Our aim? To craft a harmonious learning environment where every chime promotes calm and focus.

What Awaits with Sonarcloud:

Harmonious Transitions: Experience the soft, melodic chimes of Sonarcloud which not only signify class transitions but serve as gentle moments of pause and recalibration.

Promoting Mental Well-being: In collaboration with some dedicated partners, students will soon be treated to short, uplifting audio messages from well-known figures. Imagine the boost of motivation hearing an inspirational quote from a revered athlete or artist during the day!

Safety First, Always: Sonarcloud isn’t just about ambiance. It’s about ensuring safety, optimizing communication, and streamlining operations – a complete package.

A Partnership for Excellence:

The potential of Sonarcloud is vast, but it truly shines brightest when it's in the hands of visionary leaders like you. Together, I believe we can cultivate a school environment where well-being is at the forefront.

As we embark on this academic year, I invite you to explore the myriad ways Sonarcloud can amplify the positive vibes and operational efficiency within your institution. It's not just a tool—it's a movement, a philosophy that promises an enriching, attuned school experience.

I'd be thrilled to discuss this further or answer any queries you might have. Here's to a year filled with innovation, growth, and harmony!


​

With warm regards,

Sonarcloud Team

source.subject: Your Sonarcloud device (Franklin K. Lane PA System) is down - Troubleshooting
source.body:
Hello!


We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (Franklin K. Lane PA System) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.


Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't receive announcements either.


If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.


If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.


Thank you and have a fantastic day!



You have received this e-mail because we are monitoring your Sonarcloud device. If you would like us to stop monitoring your Sonarcloud device, simply reply to this e-mail and let us know.

source.subject: Best Practices for Mental Health & Success: A Guide for Administrators in the New School Year
source.body:
Hi Marjorie,

The dawn of a new school year brings excitement, challenges, and opportunities. As administrators, you’re in a unique position to shape the mental landscape of your institution. Drawing upon insights and our experience at Sonarcloud, here are some strategies to ensure success and well-being.

1. Embrace Brain Health:

The brain is central to all we do. Recognizing the importance of mental well-being isn’t just essential; it’s transformative. Keep in mind that “Your wellness and peace are a priority; everything else is secondary.”

2. Acknowledge and Grow:

While the past holds valuable lessons, it’s essential to cultivate an environment of positivity and forward momentum. Remember, “Our past is a lesson, not a life sentence.”

3. Invest in Self-care:

Taking time for self-care isn’t selfish. It’s the fuel that drives success. Be it meditation, reading, or exercise — make it a priority.

4. Open Dialogues Foster Growth:

Encourage open conversations about mental health. Destigmatize discussions, and know that “Being vulnerable is the first step towards freedom.”

5. Seek Continuous Learning:

The realm of mental health is expansive. Stay informed. Attend workshops, join webinars, and imbibe knowledge that ensures the well-being of your educational community.

6. Work-Life Harmony Over Balance:

Life isn’t always about balance; it’s about harmony. Encourage teachers and students alike to find that harmonious blend in their academic and personal lives.

7. Nutrition is Key:

Diet impacts our mental health in profound ways. Promote brain-boosting foods and encourage conscious living and mindful consumption.

8. Incorporate Mindfulness:

Consider practices like yoga and meditation. Simple techniques can drastically reduce stress and increase focus.

9. Stay Vigilant and Supportive:

Being observant can make all the difference. If someone seems to be struggling, approach them with empathy and provide the necessary support.

10. Celebrate Every Victory:

Regardless of size, every success is a testament to perseverance. Celebrate it. Feel gratitude, as it truly is the healthiest of all human emotions.

To wrap it up, this school year, let’s embrace holistic wellness, drawing from age-old wisdom and modern insights. At Sonarcloud, we’re with you every step of the way, ensuring a harmonious blend of academic success and mental well-being.

All the best of luck this year!!

Hi Matluck,

Discover the power of a modern communication system with SonarCloud. We're transforming traditional school bell systems with personalized educational content, inspiring announcements, and much more. Enhance your students' day-to-day experience and pave the way for a more engaging learning environment. We're offering a limited number of free consultations to help you understand how this could redefine your school. Don't miss out on this opportunity to be part of the future of education!

Schedule here

Dear SonarCloud family,

We hope this message finds you well. We are thrilled to announce that SonarCloud's original visionaries, Jesse Baptiste and Michael Leonetti, are back at the helm of the company. After a successful stint with our previous venture, we have returned, more experienced and more passionate than ever, to our original mission: transforming the school bell system and making school announcements more engaging.

First and foremost, we want to express our heartfelt appreciation to each of you. We understand that transitions can be challenging, and some of you may have experienced frustrations during our absence. We want to assure you that our renewed involvement in SonarCloud means a renewed commitment to our customers. We're back to ensure that your voices are heard, your needs are met, and that we continue to improve our service based on your feedback.

Now, for the big news: SonarCloud has partnered with Spotify! This landmark partnership will allow us to provide a fully licensed music library, offering schools a wide variety of music choices for their transitions and announcements. With this collaboration, we are giving a legal and exciting musical upgrade to the traditional school bell system.

source.subject: Your Sonarcloud device (Paul R. Brown PA System) is down - Troubleshooting
source.body:
Hello!


We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (Paul R. Brown PA System) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.


Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't receive announcements either.


If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.


If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.


Thank you and have a fantastic day!



You have received this e-mail because we are monitoring your Sonarcloud device. If you would like us to stop monitoring your Sonarcloud device, simply reply to this e-mail and let us know.

source.subject: RE: Insperity Intro Call: 3/30
source.body:
Hi David,

Following up on an email I sent recently:

I’m hoping to schedule a call for next week. My firm pools a national client base to provide Fortune 100 level benefit plans and HR infrastructure, in a cost-effective structure, at lower rates than any one of our clients could possibly negotiate independently.

We work by aggregating our clients’ employees (along with our own) into one massive group to go direct to purchase for healthcare (+400K lives on one plan). In doing this, we can provide Fortune 100 quality benefits at less than what our clients are currently spending.

We also assist with all facets of “transactional” HR, freeing up our clients to focus on strategic initiatives and revenue generation, while empowering teams with state-of-the art technology, dedicated HR professionals (per-client), and perks that wouldn’t otherwise be available outside of the Fortune 100 environment.

Are you available later this week on Thursday (30th) or Friday (31st) to discuss?

Thank you!
Mike

To: Villanueva Victor <VVillanueva2@schools.nyc.gov>
Subject: Fwd: Your Sonarcloud device (Q308 PA System) is down - Troubleshooting



Sent from my iPhone


Begin forwarded message:

From: Michael from Sonarcloud <mleonetti@getsonarcloud.com>
Date: January 24, 2023 at 6:23:35 AM EST
To: Birgeles Joseph <JBirgel@schools.nyc.gov>
Subject: Your Sonarcloud device (Q308 PA System) is down - Troubleshooting
Reply-To: Michael from Sonarcloud <michael.a.leonetti@sonarcloud.intercom-mail.com>

﻿

Hello!


We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (Q308 PA System) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.


Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't receive announcements either.


If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.


If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.


Thank you and have a fantastic day!



You have received this e-mail because we are monitoring your Sonarcloud device. If you would like us to stop monitoring your Sonarcloud device, simply reply to this e-mail and let us know. https://sonarcloud.intercom-mail.com/avatars/356407/square_128/photo-1553009601.png Michael from Sonarcloud

source.subject: How Meta Is Planning for the 2022 US Midterms
source.body:
https://go.facebookinc.com/rs/267-PVB-941/images/metalogo.png

https://go.facebookinc.com/rs/267-PVB-941/images/SafetyandIntegrity_2022Nurture_Email1_Header1.jpeg

Elections Integrity

Meta’s approach to the 2022 Midterm Elections

Meta has developed a comprehensive approach to elections on our platforms, which includes preventing election and voter interference, and connecting people with reliable information. With the US 2022 midterms on the horizon, we are outlining our approach for this election cycle, which you can read more about in our Newsroom.

https://go.facebookinc.com/rs/267-PVB-941/images/arrow-white-bg-26x26-2x.png Learn More

https://go.facebookinc.com/rs/267-PVB-941/images/SafetyandIntegrity_2022Nurture_Email1_LeftImageArticle2.png

Implementing a Restriction Period for Ads About Social Issues, Elections, or Politics in the US Since 2018, we’ve held ads about social issues, elections, or politics to a higher standard of authenticity and transparency. This midterm election is no different, we are implementing a restriction period in the US for ads about social issues, elections, or politics for the week leading up to the general election day on Tuesday, November 8.

This means that from 12:01 AM PT on November 1, 2022 through 11:59 PM PT on November 8, 2022 no new ads about social issues, elections, or politics can be published in the US, and most edits to existing ads will be prohibited. If an ad about social issues, elections or politics serves an impression before the restriction period goes into effect this ad can continue to run the week leading up to election day. https://go.facebookinc.com/rs/267-PVB-941/images/arrow-white-bg-26x26-2x.png Learn More

https://go.facebookinc.com/rs/267-PVB-941/images/SafetyandIntegrity_2022Nurture_Email1_RightImageArticle3.png

Connecting People with Reliable Information We’re continuing to connect people with details about voter registration and information from local state election officials through Feed notifications and our Voting Information Center. State and local election officials continue to use our Voting Alerts on Facebook to send the latest information about registering and voting to people in their communities.
We also help prevent the spread of misinformation with 11 fact-checking partners in the US and an investment of an additional $5 million in fact-checking and media literacy initiatives ahead of the midterms. https://go.facebookinc.com/rs/267-PVB-941/images/arrow-white-bg-26x26-2x.png Learn More

https://go.facebookinc.com/rs/267-PVB-941/images/SafetyandIntegrity_2022Nurture_Email1_LeftImageArticle4.png

Authorization Process for Running Ads about Social Issues, Elections or Politics As a reminder, advertisers who run ads about social issues, elections, or politics are required to complete an authorization process and include a “paid for by” disclaimer. These ads are then stored in our publicly available Ad Library for seven years. Earlier this year we also shared that we are bringing more transparency to these ads in the Ad Library by providing high-level information about advertiser targeting choices.
For more information about running ads about social issues, elections or politics, you can visit the Help Center and our microsite linked below.

Learn More

https://go.facebookinc.com/rs/267-PVB-941/images/SafetyandIntegrity_2022Nurture_Email1_RightImageArticle5.png

Helping Advertisers Create More Suitable Environments for their Brands We offer a variety of brand suitability controls across In-Stream, Audience Network, Instant Articles and Ads on Facebook Reels. In our in-stream environment we offer inventory filters, topic exclusions, block and allow lists along with delivery reports that can help our partners best refine inventory that is in line with their suitability needs.

Learn More

https://go.facebookinc.com/rs/267-PVB-941/images/meta-footer-logo-170x50-2x.png

source.subject: Your Sonarcloud device (Conselyea PA System) is down - Troubleshooting
source.body:
Hello!


We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (Conselyea PA System) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.


Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't receive announcements either.


If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.


If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.


Thank you and have a fantastic day!

source.subject: Your Sonarcloud device (PS X59 PA System) is down - Troubleshooting
source.body:
Hello!

We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (PS X59 PA System) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.

Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't receive announcements either.

If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.

If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.

Thank you and have a fantastic day!


You have received this e-mail because we are monitoring your Sonarcloud device. If you would like us to stop monitoring your Sonarcloud device, simply reply to this e-mail and let us know.

Hello!

I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.

Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't receive announcements either.

This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.

If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.

Thank you and have a fantastic day!

source.subject: Your Sonarcloud device (Eagle Academy PA System) is down - Troubleshooting
source.body:
Hello!

We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (Eagle Academy PA System) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.

Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't receive announcements either.

If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.

If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.

Thank you and have a fantastic day!

source.subject: Your Sonarcloud device (Tilden Avenue PA System) is down - Troubleshooting
source.body:
Hello!

We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (Tilden Avenue PA System) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.

Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't receive announcements either.

If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.

If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.

Thank you and have a fantastic day!


You have received this e-mail because we are monitoring your Sonarcloud device. If you would like us to stop monitoring your Sonarcloud device, simply reply to this e-mail and let us know.

More than 100 companies and 200 people attended our November 2021 virtual event. You’re invited. Get valuable K-12 industry intel to help you understand the changing buyer landscape. Receive critical information straight from K-12 buyers on hot topics. Learn more.

Sessions you'll attend include:

  • Culture Battles and the Future of K-12 Curriculum
    At least 15 states have approved laws that restrict lessons about racism, sexism, and concepts that are deemed “divisive.” These policies are being closely watched by many parents, school advocates, and companies. But to what extent are they actually shaping the work of curriculum providers? Insiders who know the industry give us their predictions on how the next year will play out.

    Many organizations trying to work with district customers say they want to use account-based marketing principles, or that they’re using it already. But what does it look like in practice? We’ll talk with an expert on how to apply ABM in practice, and what it means in terms of not only acquiring new sales, but meeting their ongoing needs for retention.
  • The Future of Tutoring: What Districts Want, and How They Will Judge Providers
    Districts are using a flood of federal stimulus funding and other sources to invest heavily in academic intervention for students who have struggled during COVID. But how are school systems making basic decisions about the quality of providers, the qualifications of instructors, how many providers to choose, and – perhaps most important – making decisions about whether to sustain that work over time?

source.subject: FKL (19K420) PA System
source.body:
Dear Mr. Baptiste,

Thank you for your time today. As we discussed, the antiquated PA system (complete with analog switches) at our building is in need of an upgrade, and DSF is aware of the safety issues posed by having an unreliable PA system that often freezes up (and our custodial engineer is cc’d), but any coaxing that could move the upgrade project along would be most helpful, thanks.

As for the errant bells, there may be a fried wire somewhere, or (more likely) a system point was inadvertently activated the last time someone accessed the PA system programming (which I think happened on 4/18). I believe that the system point in question is associated with a hallway PA speaker on the second floor, not a classroom or office, which may be where the confusion lies, since unlike classrooms and offices, hallways do not have official room numbers assigned. That stated, I believe the system point(s) associated with this issue align to “room” 209 and/or 299. But that’s just my best guess – we will have to do a PA point check when a PA system tech with the proper software/laptop for hookup to the PA system arrives. I am hoping that will be tomorrow.

Thanks again,

Jim Maguire

Assistant Principal Admin

Franklin K. Lane Campus

999 Jamaica Avenue

Brooklyn, NY, 11208

jmaguir2@schools.nyc.gov

718-647-2100, ext. 1730

To: Rashiem O'Connor <rashiem.oconnor@afterschoolallstars.org>
Subject: Your Sonarcloud device (PS 272 PA System) is down - Troubleshooting

Hello!

We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (PS 272 PA System) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.

Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't send announcements either.

If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.

If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.

Thank you and have a fantastic day!

Michael from Sonarcloud

source.body:
Hello!

We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (KAPPA VI PA System) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.

Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't receive announcements either.

If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.

If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.

Thank you and have a fantastic day!

source.body:
Hello!

We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (PS 527 PA System) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.

Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't receive announcements either.

If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.

If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.

Thank you and have a fantastic day!

source.subject: Your Sonarcloud device (PS 109 PA System) is down - Troubleshooting
source.body:
Hello!

We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (PS 109 PA System) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.

Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't receive announcements either.

If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.

If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.

Thank you and have a fantastic day!


You have received this e-mail because we are monitoring your Sonarcloud device. If you would like us to stop monitoring your Sonarcloud device, simply reply to this e-mail and let us know.

source.subject: Your Sonarcloud device (PS 136Q PA System) is down - Troubleshooting
source.body:
Hello!

We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (PS 136Q PA System) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.

Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't receive announcements either.

If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.

If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.

Thank you and have a fantastic day!


You have received this e-mail because we are monitoring your Sonarcloud device. If you would like us to stop monitoring your Sonarcloud device, simply reply to this e-mail and let us know.

Multiple newsrooms solve the issue of publishing in several languages, or a brand present in different markets. With Hype.News multiple newsrooms your brand can consist of several newsrooms, each having its own look (if you wish) but all managed from the same place as when you have one.

Connected newsrooms
Your newsrooms stay connected. From switch on your newsroom, visitors can see your other newsrooms and open them if they are interested. This gives you the ability to segment your content but still have in interconnected and allowing visitors to move freely between your platforms.

Embedded newsrooms

source.subject: Your Sonarcloud device (Franklin K. Lane PA System) is down - Troubleshooting
source.body:
Hello!

We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (Franklin K. Lane PA System) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.

Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't receive announcements either.

If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.

If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.

Thank you and have a fantastic day!


You have received this e-mail because we are monitoring your Sonarcloud device. If you would like us to stop monitoring your Sonarcloud device, simply reply to this e-mail and let us know.

5) Pick up the phone and hang it up

source.subject: Your Sonarcloud device (WAE PA System) is down - Troubleshooting
source.body:
Hello!

We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (WAE PA System) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.

Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't receive announcements either.

If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.

If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.

Thank you and have a fantastic day!


You have received this e-mail because we are monitoring your Sonarcloud device. If you would like us to stop monitoring your Sonarcloud device, simply reply to this e-mail and let us know.

source.body:
Hello

It looks like your Sonarcloud device (Tilden Avenue PA System) has come back up. Yay!

Announcements that you make through your apps will now go out as expected. You do not need to take any further action towards fixing your device.

If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to us at any time.

Have a fantastic day!


You have received this e-mail because we are monitoring your Sonarcloud device. If you would like us to stop monitoring your Sonarcloud device, simply reply to this e-mail and let us know.
Good afternoon, please allow the following users to access our school's Sonarcloud PA system. Email: Vrosignano@schools.nyc.gov and Rrivera12@schools.nyc.gov thanks
Good day, I am having an issue with Sonarcloud. I have turned off a set of bells to maintain a quiet environment during testing, but they are still playing.

Hello!

We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (Eagle Academy PA System) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.

Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't send announcements either.

If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.

If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.

Thank you and have a fantastic day!

source.subject: Your Sonarcloud device (MS 45 PA System) is down - Troubleshooting
source.body:
Hello!

We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (MS 45 PA System) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.

Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't receive announcements either.

If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.

If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.

Thank you and have a fantastic day!


You have received this e-mail because we are monitoring your Sonarcloud device. If you would like us to stop monitoring your Sonarcloud device, simply reply to this e-mail and let us know.

source.subject: Your Sonarcloud device (PS 178 PA) is down - Troubleshooting
source.body:
Hello!

We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (PS 178 PA) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.

Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't receive announcements either.

If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.

If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.

Thank you and have a fantastic day!


You have received this e-mail because we are monitoring your Sonarcloud device. If you would like us to stop monitoring your Sonarcloud device, simply reply to this e-mail and let us know.

source.subject: Your Sonarcloud device (PS 109 PA System) is down - Troubleshooting
source.body:
Hello!

We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (PS 109 PA System) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.

Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't send announcements either.

If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.

If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.

Thank you and have a fantastic day!

Michael A. Leonetti

source.body:
Good afternoon Jesse,

We have been experiencing some sound quality issues throughout our school and after technicians tested the PA system they believe that the issue might be the way we are making announcements thru sonarcloud. They recommended that we make sure that sonarcloud is using the #00 code to access the system. Can you confirm that this is the code used? If not is there a way to make this the default code?

Thank you,

Juan Velez

School Computer Technology Specialist lvl III
William Cullen Bryant High School

48-10 31st Avenue Long Island City, NY 11103

(718) 721-5404 ext 3430

JVelez@schools.nyc.gov

From: Manolios Vasilios <VManoli2@schools.nyc.gov>
Sent: Wednesday, March 24, 2021 10:41 AM
To: Velez Juan <JVelez@schools.nyc.gov>; Dwarka Namita <NDwarka@schools.nyc.gov>; Crea Allissa <ACrea@schools.nyc.gov>; Huezo Henri <HHuezo@schools.nyc.gov>; Manolios Vasilios <VManoli2@schools.nyc.gov>; Morales Moises <MMorales9@schools.nyc.gov>; Papoutsis Pelagia <PPapoutsis@schools.nyc.gov>; St. Aubain Carlyn <CStaubain@schools.nyc.gov>; Winberry Valerie <VWinberry@schools.nyc.gov>; Young Jonathan <JYoung22@schools.nyc.gov>
Subject: PA

Hello All,

It seems the issue with the PA system has to do with Sonarcloud. We need to make sure that the company is using #00 when accessing the system. If they are using another code, the issue may be that only one amp is being used to make the announcement, which would be splitting the signal in half.

I suggest that we contact the company to ensure they are using the right codes. Once we confirm, we need to test it when students are not in the building.

Best,

Bill Manolios

Assistant Principal

William Cullen Bryant High School

VManoli2@schools.nyc.gov

To: Culpeper Brown Natalie <NCulpeperBrown@schools.nyc.gov>
Subject: Your Sonarcloud device (PS 213Q PA System) is down - Troubleshooting



Hello!

We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (PS 213Q PA System) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.

Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't receive announcements either.

If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.

If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.

Thank you and have a fantastic day!

You have received this e-mail because we are monitoring your Sonarcloud device. If you would like us to stop monitoring your Sonarcloud device, simply reply to this e-mail and let us know.

source.subject: Your Sonarcloud device (PS 375 PA System) is down - Troubleshooting
source.body:
Hello!

We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (PS 375 PA System) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.

Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't send announcements either.

If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.

If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.

Thank you and have a fantastic day!

Hi Elba,

Introducing Jenerus
​

Our company is currently working on a new project called Jenerus, and I wanted to share some information about it with you. I think it might be a good resource for helping students and their families experiencing food insecurity at P.S./ I.S. 155 Nicholas Herkimer and I would appreciate your feedback.

Jenerus is a platform which allows individuals and families in need to buy groceries using Instacart or Walmart groceries, instead of solely using school-based meal resources or city-wide food pantries. Families can download the Apple/Android app or use the browser-based extension on our website, log into online grocery partners directly through our platform, and create a shopping cart. They can then “sync” their cart to our application with one button click, allowing donors to see their cart. Our donors can contribute funds towards their grocery bill using crowdfunding technology. A one time use gift card will be generated when the cart is funded, which can only be used for items at the specific grocery partner where the cart was created. This way, donors can be assured that their money is being spent specifically on food and other related essentials. Families have the option of having the food delivered to their home, for no extra cost.

We think that this makes sense for NYC schools for the following reasons:

  1. The effort to combat food insecurity for NYC students during the current pandemic has been massive. But there are still significant gaps in reaching all families in need. A recent poll done by The Education Trust – New York showed that half of NYC families have skipped or reduced meals for their families during the current pandemic, and over half of the parents of elementary students were concerned about their child’s access to food during this Fall. One researcher at Brookings Institution found that of all low income households who qualify for free/reduced price school meals, only 15% of those who qualify are receiving them.
  2. “Grab and Go” models of reducing food insecurity require parents to pick up their child’s free meals at specific times. The same holds true for in-person pantries providing emergency food in NYC. As beneficial as these resources are, many parents are working during distribution hours, do not have the transportation needed, or many not feel comfortable picking up food during the pandemic due to underlying health issues.
  3. Although programs such as SNAP remain an important resource, 50% of SNAP beneficiaries remain food insecure, with more than half running out of SNAP benefits within the first two weeks of the month. This can lead to an increase in disciplinary issues and a decrease in test scores towards the end of the month, once benefits are exhausted.

We know that students experiencing hunger cannot learn, as food insecure children, who often have poor physical and emotional health, have poor educational engagement. We believe that Jenerus’ model fills a necessary gap in providing crowdfunded, supplemental groceries. Families have the dignity of choosing their own food and other necessities for their shopping cart (including items that may not be as easy to come by in pantries, such as diapers), the time saving convenience of having the food shipped directly to home, and access to the same contact-free delivery of non-expired and fresh products that other parents are able to utilize. This is all done using our crowdfunding model, facilitating aide from an online support network of donors.

We would be interested in partnering with P.S./ I.S. 155 Nicholas Herkimer, by creating a group just for P.S./ I.S. 155 Nicholas Herkimer parents. You would be able to notify parents about the app and give them access to a specific link, which they would use to log in. They would then be automatically added to a P.S./ I.S. 155 Nicholas Herkimer group. That way, parents could post shopping carts or donate to others within the P.S./ I.S. 155 Nicholas Herkimer Jenerus community.

I am excited about rolling out this platform to as many families as can benefit from it and look forward to speaking with you further about how we can face this issue together, adding another resource that parents can be made aware of.

Have a Happy Holidays.
