source.subject: quick question
source.body:
Hi David,

I found your info on LinkedIn and wanted to reach out. Please excuse me for the cold email but I thought you would find a ton of value.

https://media.giphy.com/media/IThjAlJnD9WNO/giphy.gif

El Toro has invented and patented ad targeting tech by mapping over 170 million IP addresses back to their physical address. This means we’re able to place digital ads on a 1-to-1 basis in front of the people in a household when they’re browsing the Internet. This is all done without the use of pixels, keywords, or geofencing.

One of our newest tools, Digital New Movers, allows us to create constantly refreshed audiences of households that have been moved into within the last 90 days. Most recent market research says that when households move, they typically spend $9k in the first 90 days, and are 4X as likely to try a new brand, product, or service. Just by typing in a ZIP code we can find all of the "low hanging fruit" in any market.

Our clients (GE Appliances, Ashley Furniture, Ford- just to name a few) consistently see 100%+ return on ad spend from our campaigns over the past 7 years.

Would you have 15 minutes this week or next for a casual, no-pressure demo? I promise to make the call worth your while.

Thanks,

Caleb Schweinsberg

(502) 551-3025

Ranked #13 on Deloitte's 2017 Technology Fast 500

source.subject: introducing Jenerus
source.body:
Hi Jason,

Our company is currently working on a new project called Jenerus, and I wanted to share some information about it with you. I think it might be a good resource for helping students and their families experiencing food insecurity at Millennium Brooklyn HS and I would appreciate your feedback.

Jenerus is a platform which allows individuals and families in need to buy groceries using Instacart or Walmart groceries, instead of solely using school-based meal resources or city-wide food pantries. Families can download the Apple/Android app or use the browser-based extension on our website, log into online grocery partners directly through our platform, and create a shopping cart. They can then “sync” their cart to our application with one button click, allowing donors to see their cart. Our donors can contribute funds towards their grocery bill using crowdfunding technology. A one time use gift card will be generated when the cart is funded, which can only be used for items at the specific grocery partner where the cart was created. This way, donors can be assured that their money is being spent specifically on food and other related essentials. Families have the option of having the food delivered to their home, for no extra cost.

We think that this makes sense for NYC schools for the following reasons:

  1. The effort to combat food insecurity for NYC students during the current pandemic has been massive. But there are still significant gaps in reaching all families in need. A recent poll done by The Education Trust – New York showed that half of NYC families have skipped or reduced meals for their families during the current pandemic, and over half of the parents of elementary students were concerned about their child’s access to food during this Fall. One researcher at Brookings Institution found that of all low income households who qualify for free/reduced price school meals, only 15% of those who qualify are receiving them.
  2. “Grab and Go” models of reducing food insecurity require parents to pick up their child’s free meals at specific times. The same holds true for in-person pantries providing emergency food in NYC. As beneficial as these resources are, many parents are working during distribution hours, do not have the transportation needed, or many not feel comfortable picking up food during the pandemic due to underlying health issues.
  3. Although programs such as SNAP remain an important resource, 50% of SNAP beneficiaries remain food insecure, with more than half running out of SNAP benefits within the first two weeks of the month. This can lead to an increase in disciplinary issues and a decrease in test scores towards the end of the month, once benefits are exhausted.

We know that students experiencing hunger cannot learn, as food insecure children, who often have poor physical and emotional health, have poor educational engagement. We believe that Jenerus’ model fills a necessary gap in providing crowdfunded, supplemental groceries. Families have the dignity of choosing their own food and other necessities for their shopping cart (including items that may not be as easy to come by in pantries, such as diapers), the time saving convenience of having the food shipped directly to home, and access to the same contact-free delivery of non-expired and fresh products that other parents are able to utilize. This is all done using our crowdfunding model, facilitating aide from an online support network of donors.

We would be interested in partnering with Millennium Brooklyn HS, by creating a group just for Millennium Brooklyn HS parents. You would be able to notify parents about the app and give them access to a specific link, which they would use to log in. They would then be automatically added to a Millennium Brooklyn HS group. That way, parents could post shopping carts or donate to others within the Millennium Brooklyn HS Jenerus community.

I am excited about rolling out this platform to as many families as can benefit from it and look forward to speaking with you further about how we can face this issue together, adding another resource that parents can be made aware of.

Have a Happy Holidays.

source.body:
Hello!

We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (St. Joseph's PA System) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.

Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't receive announcements either.

If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.

If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.

Thank you and have a fantastic day!

source.subject: Your Sonarcloud device (Tilden Avenue PA System) is down - Troubleshooting
source.body:
Hello!

We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (Tilden Avenue PA System) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.

Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't receive announcements either.

If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.

If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.

Thank you and have a fantastic day!


You have received this e-mail because we are monitoring your Sonarcloud device. If you would like us to stop monitoring your Sonarcloud device, simply reply to this e-mail and let us know.

Hello,

We recently announced several new features as part of the Airtable platform. To support these enhancements, and to better explain our services and what we ask of our customers, we've updated our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

Please follow the links above to review the updates in their entirety. Here are some highlights:

Terms of Service

  • We've made changes throughout to ensure the terms are clear and informative, and cover all of our products and services.
  • We've updated our license and usage restrictions to clarify who is eligible to use Airtable and how customers may and may not use the platform.
  • With the launch of Airtable Apps, we've added terms (and incorporated our Developer Policy) to ensure applications built on Airtable protect our customers and meet our security, design, and compliance standards.
  • We've added provisions requiring the use of individual arbitration to resolve disputes between Airtable and our customers.

source.subject: Your Sonarcloud device (PS 272 PA System) is down - Troubleshooting
source.body:
Hello!

We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (PS 272 PA System) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.

Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't receive announcements either.

If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.

If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.

Thank you and have a fantastic day!


You have received this e-mail because we are monitoring your Sonarcloud device. If you would like us to stop monitoring your Sonarcloud device, simply reply to this e-mail and let us know.

source.subject: ZincFive - The Safe Alternative Chemistry
source.body:
Hello David!

ZincFive’s revolutionary Nickel-Zinc (NiZn) Battery Cabinet solution for 265kW - 1.2MW systems is an ideal alternative for UPS battery backup. NiZn batteries are high power density batteries with small size and weight with rapid charge/discharge capabilities across a wide temperature range without the threat of thermal runaway. Are you interested in lithium, but worried about fire safety? Nickel Zinc (NiZn) is the safer and easier installation choice for your data center backup solution. It provides many benefits and none of the worry. If this interests you, select the link below to schedule a quick introductory meeting to find out more about this innovative technology.

Click to Schedule: Nickel Zinc Cabinet Introduction

End Users Want Nickel-Zinc Battery Back-up in Their Data Centers… Here’s why

· 2-10 min back up: Nickel-Zinc (NiZn) is a high-power density battery vs. energy battery.

Save money/space (less aisle width): 10-year TCO analysis demonstrates NiZn offers an average of 50% savings over lead acid (fewer battery replacements) and 21% savings over Li-ion. ZincFive offers a 10-year Full Warranty up to 35°C (with excursions up to 50°C). Using NiZn offers up to 62% space savings over VRLA and 31% over Li-ion.

· Reliable, Safe Green:

Ø Reliability: NiZn weak or depleted cells/blocs remain conductive and the string continues to operate.

Ø Safety: NiZn does not go into thermal runaway

Ø Recycling: NiZn does not contain lead/acid/lithium. Recyclability is an equivalent process with lead acid.

· Easy to install solution & low maintenance:

Ø Li-ion batteries ship separate and must be assembled on-site (each cabinet = 2 Techs @ 4 hours).

Ø NiZn is a drop in replacement cabinet with low install time. PMs on VRLA and Li-ion are nearly 2x the cost compared to NiZn (NiZn is <3 hours annual PM for 1-1.2MW).

source.subject: Your Sonarcloud device (Conselyea PA System) is down - Troubleshooting
source.body:
Hello!

We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (Conselyea PA System) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.

Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't receive announcements either.

If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.

If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.

Thank you and have a fantastic day!


You have received this e-mail because we are monitoring your Sonarcloud device. If you would like us to stop monitoring your Sonarcloud device, simply reply to this e-mail and let us know.

source.subject: Your Sonarcloud device (PS 251 PA) is down - Troubleshooting
source.body:
Hello!

We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (PS 251 PA) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.

Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't receive announcements either.

If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.

If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.

Thank you and have a fantastic day!


You have received this e-mail because we are monitoring your Sonarcloud device. If you would like us to stop monitoring your Sonarcloud device, simply reply to this e-mail and let us know.

source.subject: Your Sonarcloud device (Prep Academy PA System) is down - Troubleshooting
source.body:
Hello!

We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (Prep Academy PA System) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.

Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't receive announcements either.

If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.

If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.

Thank you and have a fantastic day!


You have received this e-mail because we are monitoring your Sonarcloud device. If you would like us to stop monitoring your Sonarcloud device, simply reply to this e-mail and let us know.

source.subject: Your Sonarcloud device (Tilden Avenue PA System) is down - Troubleshooting
source.body:
Hello!

We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (Tilden Avenue PA System) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.

Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't receive announcements either.

If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.

If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.

Thank you and have a fantastic day!


You have received this e-mail because we are monitoring your Sonarcloud device. If you would like us to stop monitoring your Sonarcloud device, simply reply to this e-mail and let us know.

Time's running out to enter the Big50 Startup Competition - enter now!

https://xi83m.mjt.lu/tplimg/xi83m/b/x9r78/gmwik.png https://xi83m.mjt.lu/tplimg/xi83m/b/x9r78/gmwiv.png

Big50 Startup Competition to Pitch for Sierra Ventures - Enter Today!

Hey David,

We’re reaching out to startups to let you know about a cool, but time-sensitive, opportunity. We’d like to introduce you to technology journalist Jeff Vance’s annual Big50 Startup Competition. AirDeck is going to participate as an advisor/tech partner this year, and we’d like to invite you to enter the fray.

You may recognize Jeff from his articles in Network World, CIO, Forbes, Wired, and several other publications. His Big50 competition costs nothing to enter, and it offers entrepreneurs a platform to showcase their startups to VCs, enterprise buyers, and the high-tech press. Entries could have the opportunity to pitch to the CXO Advisory board of Sierra Ventures. This is a time-sensitive opportunity, so be sure to take the Sierra Ventures-Startup50 Customer Challenge today!

Take Big50 Questionnaire https://xi83m.mjt.lu/tplimg/xi83m/b/x9r78/gmwir.png

What's the Big50?

Big50 Overview: The Big50 tests startups with a series of challenges that map to the real-world challenges startups will face as they scale up. Winners of each challenge earn points towards inclusion in Jeff’s annual Big50 Hot Startup Report, along with prizes specific to each challenge. The current challenge, hosted by Mark Fernandes, Managing Director of Sierra Ventures, evaluates startups based on their strategies to attract customers during a tough economy.

The Challenge

Put your skills to the test: The Sierra Ventures’ challenge culminates in a presentation challenge. 25 finalists will be asked to submit a 3-minute video or slide presentation via AirDeck that pitches your product or service to enterprise buyers. Two winners will then be selected to pitch 3 enterprise CXOs from Sierra Ventures CXO Advisory Board. AirDeck is the official presentation platform for the Big50, and is quickly becoming the standard for startup pitch decks. An AirDeck narrated presentation is faster than creating a video, and more powerful than PowerPoint.

Extended Deadline from AirDeck

You’ll see on Startup50 that the deadline for this challenge is EOD Tuesday, August 11. We know this is a pretty tight deadline, so we asked Jeff to extend it for you. On the questionnaire, when you are asked “How did you hear about the Big50?” just write “AirDeck” and your deadline will automatically be extended to EOD Friday, August 14.

Good luck,

-The AirDeck Team

source.subject: Your Sonarcloud device (East Harlem Scholars HS PA) is down - Troubleshooting
source.body:
Hello!

We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (East Harlem Scholars HS PA) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.

Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't send announcements either.

If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.

If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.

Thank you and have a fantastic day!
Good morning, Happy Friday

Michael A. Leonetti

source.subject: Your Sonarcloud device (Tilden Avenue PA System) is down - Troubleshooting
source.body:
Hello!

We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (Tilden Avenue PA System) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.

Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't send announcements either.

If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.

If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.

Thank you and have a fantastic day!

source.subject: Inquiry On Sonarcloud - Christiana Owusu-Ampaw
source.body:
Hello,


I hope this email finds you well. My name is Christiana Owusu-Ampaw and I am a student at New Visions Charter High School For Advanced Math and Science. A group of seniors and I are conducting an experiment on our school bell system. Instead of our regular bell system, we decided to play different genres of music. We are aware that your company focuses on bell systems and we would love to learn more about it.


My group noticed that there is a strong correlation between the school bell system and the prison bell system. Thus, rather than encouraging a sound as the bell sound, we are trying to switch to music as the bell sound. After conducting an experiment, we are encouraged that students are more motivated to go to class after hearing to music that they are familiar to.


We would love to have a conversation with you to learn more about your company and how you work with bell systems. We would really love to see a future with this project because we believe there need to be changes in the school system as a whole.


Thank you so much and hope to hear from you soon.


You could reach me through this email or at 917-891-5610.


Sincerely,

Christiana Owusu-Ampaw

source.subject: Your Sonarcloud device (PS 91 PA System) is down - Troubleshooting
source.body:
Hello!

We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (PS 91 PA System) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.

Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't send announcements either.

If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.

If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.

Thank you and have a fantastic day!

source.subject: Sonarcloud Update on COVID-19
source.body:
Hi Parris,

I wanted to reach out to you personally to share the steps we are taking in response to the coronavirus (COVID-19) outbreak, including how it pertains to the services we provide for our customers and extended community.
​

  • Continued Service: You will continue to receive the same level of service and accessibility to the Sonarcloud platform, along with continued full engagement from our Customer Success, Program Management and Production Support teams. In addition, all of our system support functions remain completely online. 
  • Remote Team: Additionally, we wanted to share that as a precautionary measure, our team will be working from home to ensure the safety of our employees, their families, and our customers. We will continue to run our business 24/7 and anticipate no impact on the level of service you receive. 
  • Third Parties/Installation Team: Furthermore, we have been working with our 3rd party providers to understand any potential impact on their services, while developing contingency plans to avoid any disruption to your organization. As of now, we anticipate no disruption or minor slight delays.

We will stay in touch to keep you aware of any further decisions or adjustments and, as always, want to thank you for your continued partnership with Sonarcloud. At times like these, we are especially grateful for the strength of our community and the strong bonds we have built together.
 
Sincerely,

Maintenance planned for Saturday, May 16

All Zapier.com pages and services will be unavailable for 30‑60 minutes.

We want to let you know about a planned maintenance period on Saturday, May 16, 2020.

All Zapier and Zapier.com services will be unavailable for up to 60 minutes starting at 9 p.m. PDT on Saturday May 16, 2020 (4:00 UTC on Sunday, May 17th). During this maintenance period, access to your account will be unavailable, and new tasks won't process until the maintenance is complete.

Access to Zapier.com will resume as soon as the maintenance ends.

Here's what you can expect to happen with your Zaps:

  • Zaps with Instant triggers will not run during this time, but they will continue to receive information from your apps and will resume once the maintenance is complete.
  • Polling triggers will also experience a delay. After the maintenance ends, these Zaps should retrieve any objects that would normally have triggered during the outage, but your tasks may be held if there were more than 100 triggers at a time. Any held tasks can be released from your Task History.

source.subject: Giving Tuesday
source.body:
Will You Inspire Reece Students to Grow?

Dear Friends and Family,

I hope you and your family are healthy and safe during this uncertain time.

This week, I’ve been reflecting on a quote by Abraham Lincoln:

“The dogmas of the quiet past are inadequate to the stormy present. The occasion is piled high with difficulty and we must rise with the occasion. As our case is new, we must think anew and act anew. We must disenthrall ourselves, and then we shall save our country.”

During this pandemic, the resilience and adaptability of our students has been incredible to witness.

We have moved to individualized online distance learning sessions with educators, therapists and special service providers. Our students continue to receive instruction that is focused on learning rather compliance; investigation rather than test taking; and creativity.

Yes, above all else, creativity.

Abraham Lincoln’s words are especially resonant today. COVID-19 has forced us to ‘think anew and act anew.’ Our faculty and staff have worked alongside you, our parents, to create a dynamic environment in which your children can learn and grow. Together, we are creating a culture of creativity that does not ‘teach to the test’, but instead inspires curiosity in each and every Reece student.

I challenge you to support us in our efforts to inspire creativity in our students. I challenge you to ‘think anew and act anew.’

Donate here: https://www.reeceschool.org/2020/05/will-you-inspire-reece-students-to-grow-givingtuesday/

Will you give and help our students grow creatively? Will you support our students’ learning when they need you most?

Sincerely,

Duncan Lester

source.subject: Devices and probable mis-deliveries/thefts
source.body:
Dear Colleagues,


Hoping this email finds you and your families and loved ones well.


In the midst of these sad and horrible times, there are people who will always be who they are - inhuman and opportunistic 🙁


I hope that these are just isolated incidents and that the devices have been misplaced instead of stolen.


When a couple of parents reached out to me to inform me that they had not received a device from the DOE, I asked them to call to get an update. Upon calling, they were informed that the device had been delivered the previous day. They don't know how or who accepted those devices since they have to show proof via a text or email they've received from the DOE. They were given an incident number and were asked to wait for a response.


I then contacted my niece and asked if she had received a device(she applied the same day that the news came about the devices). When she said no, I asked her to call the numbers and she, too, was told that her device was delivered the day before yesterday. She now has an incident number and her child still does not have a device.


So, why am I emailing you? So that you are aware and maybe send a message to your communities to be alert and to follow up. The numbers I was given to call for inquiring and follow up are the following: 718-935-5200; 718-935-5020 and 718-935-5100. They will be transferred a couple of times, but eventually someone will take the case.


I have checked the spreadsheet that has been sent to us with information about who has requested, who is waiting and who has received their device. Just double check.


Take care and have a great day.


Dr. Marybelle Ferreira

Principal of The Academy of Creative Minds

source.subject: Your Sonarcloud device (New Visions Charter HS IV PA) is down - Troubleshooting
source.body:
Hello!

We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (New Visions Charter HS IV PA) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.

Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't receive announcements either.

If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.

If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.

Thank you and have a fantastic day!


You have received this e-mail because we are monitoring your Sonarcloud device. If you would like us to stop monitoring your Sonarcloud device, simply reply to this e-mail and let us know.

source.subject: Your Sonarcloud device (Hamilton Grange PA System) is down - Troubleshooting
source.body:
Hello!

We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (Hamilton Grange PA System) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.

Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't receive announcements either.

If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.

If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.

Thank you and have a fantastic day!


You have received this e-mail because we are monitoring your Sonarcloud device. If you would like us to stop monitoring your Sonarcloud device, simply reply to this e-mail and let us know.

source.subject: Tools for educators impacted by COVID-19
source.body:
Tools for educators impacted by COVID-19

Dear David,

As a member of the ISTE/EdSurge community, we are reaching out to you because we know the coronavirus is on everyone’s minds, especially with the recent cancellations of schools around the country. ISTE is working closely with states and partner organizations to provide the best support to schools during this critical time. One thing we’ve heard loud and clear is that educators want a single location where they can go to find information about resources that are available to them. They have also expressed feeling overwhelmed with the amount of messages that they have been receiving.

To help address both of these concerns, ISTE has launched LearningKeepsGoing.org with online tools and resources from the edtech community.

Do you have free products and resources available for schools that have closed?

If so, please take a moment to complete this survey.

With the information you provide, ISTE will be curating and sharing these resources with our educator community beginning next week. Filling this out at your earliest convenience will help us collect as much information for our educators as possible, but we also expect this to be an ongoing effort.

Thank you for your support to educators and students during this unprecedented time and together we can make a difference!

With the sincerest gratitude,
Richard

source.subject: Your Sonarcloud device (IS 211 PA System) is down - Troubleshooting
source.body:
Hello!

We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (IS 211 PA System) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.

Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't send announcements either.

If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.

If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.

Thank you and have a fantastic day!

source.subject: Your Sonarcloud device (UC/AF Brooklyn PA System) is down - Troubleshooting
source.body:
Hello!

We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (UC/AF Brooklyn PA System) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.

Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't receive announcements either.

If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.

If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.

Thank you and have a fantastic day!


You have received this e-mail because we are monitoring your Sonarcloud device. If you would like us to stop monitoring your Sonarcloud device, simply reply to this e-mail and let us know.

source.subject: Science Animated - Enquiry
source.body:
Dear David,

My name is Julian Barrett and I work for a UK based scientific and research animation agency.

I came across your details online and wonder if any of our work could prove valuable for Sonarcloud, either now or in the future.

Science Animated work across various commercial and academic sectors, creating highly engaging animated productions which can be used for key digital messaging campaigns, public engagement, generic outreach, education and internal message exchange. source.subject: Important updates to our HubSpot CRM integration
source.body:
HubSpot is streamlining its Zapier integrations and focusing development efforts on a single app. https://cdn.zapier.com/storage/photos/4d8cb9ab0434def261f7091d4f1bca50.png https://cdn.zapier.com/storage/photos/ed0003071c143da23071bd640cb94e70.png

Updates to our HubSpot CRM integration

We're reaching out because HubSpot has recently updated their Zapier integration, and we have some important changes to tell you about.

What's Changed?

HubSpot maintains two apps on Zapier—HubSpot and HubSpot CRM—and has decided to focus developer resources on only their main HubSpot app.

To prevent confusion and to make sure new users sign up for the main HubSpot app, we have hidden the HubSpot CRM app from our Zapier platform.

What Happens Next?

Your existing HubSpot CRM Zaps will continue to work as expected.

However, if you want to create any new Zaps using HubSpot, you'll be directed to authorize your account on the main HubSpot app.

https://cdn.zapier.com/storage/photos/3cdeb965277ed0292d889572c813e24a.png

While no action is required to keep your existing Zaps working, we encourage you to update any Zaps using HubSpot CRM to avoid future complications.

View & Update your Zaps

Got a question?

If you have questions about the changes to HubSpot's CRM integration or need help with your workflows—reply to this email or send us a message and we'll be happy to lend a hand.

source.subject: Your Sonarcloud device (Highbridge PA System) is down - Troubleshooting
source.body:
Hello!

We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (Highbridge PA System) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.

Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't receive announcements either.

If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.

If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.

Thank you and have a fantastic day!


You have received this e-mail because we are monitoring your Sonarcloud device. If you would like us to stop monitoring your Sonarcloud device, simply reply to this e-mail and let us know.

source.subject: Your Sonarcloud device (PS 136Q PA System) is down - Troubleshooting
source.body:
Hello!

We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (PS 136Q PA System) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.

Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't receive announcements either.

If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.

If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.

Thank you and have a fantastic day!

We’re writing to let you know that we’ve updated a number of our legal policies to comply with applicable law, ensure transparency, and better align with our practices. We invite you to read them in full, but below are some highlights. With these updates, Mailchimp reaffirms its commitment to data protection, compliance with applicable law, and the safeguarding of our and our users' data.

Which policies are changing?

  • We have made revisions to our Standard Terms of Use, Acceptable Use Policy, Cookie Statement, Data Processing Addendum, and Privacy Policy.

What are some of the key changes?
  • We’ve updated our Privacy Policy to better explain how we process your data in a concise and transparent format.
  • We’ve added California Consumer Privacy Act disclosures to our Privacy Policy.
  • We’ve restructured our Data Processing Addendum and added a California Consumer Privacy Act Addendum, which supplements our agreement with you and confirms our role as your service provider.
  • We’ve revised our Standard Terms of Use, Acceptable Use Policy, and Cookie Statement to better reflect all of our offerings as an all-in-one marketing platform.

What do you need to do?
  • You do not need to take any further action upon receiving this email. The new updates are effective January 1, 2020, and by continuing to use our service, you agree to the updated policies.

source.subject: Buffer in December 🎆
source.body:
It’s been an awesome year at Buffer. Let's reflect and recap the highlights!

‌ ‌ ‌

https://userimg-bee.customeriomail.com/images/client-env-87208/h7aY3r7t.png

Hi there!

230,877,605 social media posts were sent through Buffer in 2019.

Wow!

As we were putting together our annual 2019 in Numbers, we came across this stat, and it blew us away to think about how many amazing brands have grown this year. Your brand, included!

You are connecting more deeply with your audience, building lasting relationships with your customers, and strengthening your voice online.

It’s amazing to see.

In the spirit of gratitude and reflection, I’d love to share our last newsletter of 2019 with you. Below, I’ll recap all of the new features that you can use to keep building your brand in 2020. We’re excited to watch you do it!

2019 Recap

  • Dive deeper into your social analytics & insights 🎛
  • Hop onto the Stories train 🤳
  • Transform Instagram into a shopping experience 🛍
  • Keep track of all the fun hashtags #️⃣
  • Delight your audience with giveaways 🍾
  • Follow the story of a DTC brand from the very beginning 🎧

https://userimg-bee.customeriomail.com/images/client-env-87208/buffer-analyze-dashboard@2x-v3.jpg

Dive deeper into your social analytics & insights

This year, our new product Analyze officially entered into the Buffer family! You can use Analyze to connect the dots between all of your awesome content, and how it impacts your brand growth. Now you can go from being a great social media marketer to a strategically data-driven one.

Level up your social game with Analyze →

https://userimg-bee.customeriomail.com/images/client-env-87208/stories_mailing_hero@2x.png

Hop onto the Stories train!

This year, Instagram Stories really took off, and we keep seeing how strongly they resonate with audiences. That’s why we released Instagram Stories scheduling within Buffer in October. Whether or not you have a Stories strategy, now is such a good time to test it out and see what kind of Stories your audience gets excited about!

Get some Stories inspiration from 2019 →

https://userimg-bee.customeriomail.com/images/client-env-87208/Group%206.jpg

Transform Instagram into a shopping experience

You know it best — Instagram is becoming the new storefront for online brands. You can use Shop Grid to make it way easier for your audience to go from Instagram to your website, while showcasing your products and driving traffic to multiple links at once! (We also just improved this feature this month, so take a peek!)

Take a look at Shop Grid in action →

https://userimg-bee.customeriomail.com/images/client-env-87208/hashtag_manager@2x.png

Keep track of all the fun hashtags

There are so many hashtags out there that will help you reach new audiences and customers. How do you remember all of them? Hashtag Manager! Since releasing this feature in August, you can now save groups of hashtags, make sure you reuse your top performing groups, and schedule them right into your first comment, below your caption.

#welovehashtags so #Getorganized and #useHashtagManager! →

https://userimg-bee.customeriomail.com/images/client-env-87208/giveaways.jpg

Delight your audience with giveaways

Ever see brands run those super-engaging giveaways on Instagram and Facebook? You can do this too! You can manage multiple giveaways, engage with all of the participants, and choose a winner, all within Buffer Reply. This can be such a great way to build relationships with your fans, and you can make it happen in less than 5 minutes.

Create a giveaway now →

https://userimg-bee.customeriomail.com/images/client-env-87208/facebook%20cover_840x462%20%282%29.png

Follow the story of a DTC brand from the very start

One of the most exciting things we did this year was create an original five-part podcast series that went behind the scenes of a successful marketing agency as they reinvented themselves and built their own direct-to-consumer brand. We hope you enjoy their story and that it brings you inspiration for your brand in the new year!

Dive into the Breaking Brand story →

While we loved adding all of these things to Buffer this year, you really get all the credit. You are working so hard every day to build your brand, and you inspire us on a daily basis. We are so grateful for your support and to have you in the Buffer community!

Just so you know, the Buffer team will be taking a break from December 23 until January 1 to reflect, recharge and get ready for 2020. We'll be providing limited support during this time at buffer.com/support. Thank you for your understanding and we wish you a rejuvenating festive season and new year!

https://userimg-bee.customeriomail.com/images/client-env-87208/mike_e.png

Mike and the Buffer team

P.S. Are you a Shopify user? Tom, our product manager for Buffer Analyze, is exploring a feature to help Shopify businesses grow. However, he doesn’t work for or run a Shopify store to understand the real pain points. Would you help him?

source.subject: Your Sonarcloud device (Highbridge PA System) is down - Troubleshooting
source.body:
Hello!

We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (Highbridge PA System) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.

Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't send announcements either.

If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.

If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.

Thank you and have a fantastic day!

source.subject: Basic requirements
source.body:
Hi,

We have tested SonarCloud and are almost ready to implement it in our production pipelines. However before we do we would like to know how SonarCloud meets the following requirements.

Basic Requirements for Static Application Security Testing:

  1. Source Code Analyzer must be capable of analyzing the code languages in use by the program
  2. Analysis reports should be rapidly available to development team
  3. Analysis tool should be capable of flagging findings as false positive and should indicate severity of the finding.
  4. Code scanning signatures update at some regular frequency
  5. Tool shall be capable of automated code scanning, as a part of the check in/development process.

Regards,

Tony Fontanilla

Azure Linux Administrator

AMS Dataserfs

source.subject: Engage Math, Reading and other Curriculum leaders in 2020
source.body:
Breaking Through to Curriculum Leaders is hard... let EdWeek work with you to plan for 2020 success


Here's the bad news...


Based on 8 years of EdMarketer surveys of District Leaders, we know there are some sobering stats:

  • District Leaders reported spending only about 1 hour per week researching, talking to, learning from or considering new vendors;
  • 32% of district-level respondents agreed with the statement: "I don't read email from education companies."
  • 70% of District Leaders feel annoyed by the volume of email they receive from vendors

But there is good news...


District leaders have also cited best practices and strategies as the # 2 thing (after professional development) that a company could offer to assist them in their job. And our persona research has shown that C&I leaders are the district team members most likely to consume external information that can help them in their work. So, If you are looking to break through to leaders on issues of math, reading and other curriculum, an integrated, multi-modal approach is crucial.


To help you tap into this thirst for knowledge, EdWeek can work with you to build marketing campaigns that engage. Ask us about how we would best integrate a variety of marketing tactics for your specific needs, such as:

  • Enhanced Audience and Social Targeting (engaging named accounts, ideal customers and key personas on edweek.org and across the web)
  • Webinars and Online Summits (for turnkey engagement with C&I leaders hungry for best practice info)
  • Custom Content Creation and/or Content Distribution
  • Email and Email Newsletter marketing (to reach leaders in the inbox, with EdWeek as a trusted sender)
  • Leadership Dinners (for In-person engagement in an exclusive, high-touch environment)
  • Print and Online Content Targeting, including Special Reports (integrating your brand and message with deep journalism sought by District and School Leaders)

And don't forget to Save these Dates!


Many of the above opportunities are available all year long, however, some dates specific to Math, Reading and Curriculum may be worth noting on your calendar.

  • January 28, 2020 - Online Summit: Reading
  • February 5, 2020 - Special Report: Curriculum Meets the Future of Work
  • February 26, 2020 - Online Summit: Curriculum Meets the Future of Work
  • May 5, 2020 - Special Report: Math in Focus
  • May 13, 2020 - Online Summit: Math in Focus
  • Ongoing - Webinars, Spotlights, Account-based Targeting, Enhanced Social Targeting, and more reaching leadership audiences engaged in Curriculum and Instruction

source.subject: Your Sonarcloud device (Gulliver 2) is down - Troubleshooting
source.body:
Hello!

We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (Gulliver 2) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.

Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't receive announcements either.

If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.

If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.

Thank you and have a fantastic day!


You have received this e-mail because we are monitoring your Sonarcloud device. If you would like us to stop monitoring your Sonarcloud device, simply reply to this e-mail and let us know.

source.subject: Tilden Avenue PA system
source.body:
Good afternoon!

After visiting with your school it has been brought to our attention that there are a couple of issues going on at once.

Issue 1: The Sonarcloud system needs a part replaced.

Issue 2: The PA system has lost is programming associating rooms to different zones.


Issue 1 is easy. We will be there this week to address this issue and get it settled.


Issue 2 is a little bit more complicated. We'll need to do reprogramming on your PA system to make this work. I want to offer you all of your options in getting Issue 2 settled. You can either reach out to DSF and put in a work order for them to come out and re-zone your PA system, or we can send a tech to do it for you. I'm sure you're familiar with the DSF side (have the custodian put in a work order, wait for them to come, etc). Let me list what we'd need to get the programming done in the school.

To have us do the rezoning for you it would require:

  1. A separate payment of $550 (as this is outside of the Sonarcloud annual service fee). You can split payment up between as many schools as you'd like. The total will be $550 and not $550 per school. However, we'd need a certified PO before we could get started or whatever certified form of payment you'd use.
  2. If 1 is agreeable, we'd need a spreadsheet of each room in the building and what zone (school) it is supposed to belong to (please include hallway instructions, ex: 2nd floor hallway Kurt Hann or 2nd floor hallway all call only). This we'd need prior to going on-site so we're not wasting anybody's time.

Whichever route you choose, either DSF or us, Sonarcloud will still function as long as the PA is properly zoned.

Please let me know if you have any questions! Have a fantastic day!

-- Michael A. Leonetti As warm as green tea Sonarcloud PO Box 531 Livingston, NJ 07039 718-407-0664, Ext. 100 888-874-6551 getsonarcloud.com Support: support@getsonarcloud.com

Technology based innovation is transforming the world around us at a rapid pace. Digital technologies are adding the much-needed impetus to the Fourth Industrial Revolution by making the overall transactions more seamless, automated, productive, and efficient.

All businesses need to be mindful of this new-found agility and efficacy in order to navigate through today’s competitive market.

Leveraging these cutting-edge technologies in ways in which business profitability is enhanced, will be vital to sustain in the Age of Digital Transformation.

Share

RPA Tools Research Digest

https://cdn.substack.com/image/fetch/w_1572,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good/https%3A%2F%2Fbucketeer-e05bbc84-baa3-437e-9518-adb32be77984.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F006a5f8f-1756-47c1-a6b5-b49969edd095_786x524.jpeg [Brief Paper] Ironies of Automation

This paper discusses the ways in which automation of industrial processes may expand rather than eliminate problems with the human operator.

Some comments will be made on methods of alleviating these problems within the “classic” approach of leaving the operator with responsibility for abnormal conditions, and on the potential for continued use of the human operator for on-line decision-making within human-computer collaboration.

The Reskilling Toolkit contains information, guidance, tips, and resources on how to reskill and/or upskill employees impacted by major workforce changes, such as automation.

The toolkit aligns to the Human Capital Framework (HCF), which guides agencies through the four different systems of the human capital management life cycle.

Continuous reskilling and upskilling contributes to fostering a culture of continuous learning.

By actively managing the workforce and developing agile operations, agencies better position themselves for effective and efficient achievement of their mission and goals.

rpatools.org • Share

https://cdn.substack.com/image/fetch/w_1200,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good/https%3A%2F%2Fbucketeer-e05bbc84-baa3-437e-9518-adb32be77984.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F23cb05ff-d1bf-498e-bcd5-91eef25f0e26_600x600.jpeg [RESEARCH] Small Cities Face Greater Impact From Automation

Cities, which accommodate over half of the world’s population, are modern society’s hubs for economic productivity and innovation. As job migration is the leading factor in urbanization, policymakers are increasingly concerned about the impact of artificial intelligence and automation on employment in cities. In a world struggling between localism and globalism, a question emerges:

How Will Different Cities Cope With Automation?

Answering this question has implications on everything from urban migration to investment, and from social welfare policy to educational initiatives.

For a fairer society it is important that we consider ownership models of technologies whilst being cautious not to stifle innovation.

source.subject: Your Sonarcloud device (Northeast PA System) is down - Troubleshooting
source.body:
Hello!

We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (Northeast PA System) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.

Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't send announcements either.

If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.

If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.

Thank you and have a fantastic day!

Hello!

Just checking in. Have you had a chance to consider what you will do about reprogramming the PA system? Just a refresher on the issue, here is an excerpt from my original e-mail.

We'll need to do reprogramming on your PA system to make this work. I want to offer you all of your options in getting Issue 2 settled. You can either reach out to DSF and put in a work order for them to come out and re-zone your PA system, or we can send a tech to do it for you. I'm sure you're familiar with the DSF side (have the custodian put in a work order, wait for them to come, etc). Let me list what we'd need to get the programming done in the school.

To have us do the rezoning for you it would require:

  1. A separate payment of $550 (as this is outside of the Sonarcloud annual service fee). You can split payment up between as many schools as you'd like. The total will be $550 and not $550 per school. However, we'd need a certified PO before we could get started or whatever certified form of payment you'd use.
  2. If 1 is agreeable, we'd need a spreadsheet of each room in the building and what zone (school) it is supposed to belong to (please include hallway instructions, ex: 2nd floor hallway Kurt Hann or 2nd floor hallway all call only). This we'd need prior to going on-site so we're not wasting anybody's time.

Whichever route you choose, either DSF or us, Sonarcloud will still function as long as the PA is properly zoned.

Overcoming 3 challenges of introducing blended learning in the classroom

Throughout the world, many public schools still rely heavily on text-based core curriculum. Introducing blended learning experiences in core subjects presents many opportunities over traditional print-heavy classrooms.

Neo LMS

https://www.edtechupdate.com/thumbs/9/1/e/91ed7815197824b5322594e0d2f34240a6cd364d.jpg

How teachers address cell phones in class

I teach online grad school classes in how to integrate tech into education. One topic I always ask students is how they manage cell phone usage in their classes. Protocols for these mobile devices have little in common today with how they were addressed a decade ago.

Ask a Tech Teacher

https://www.edtechupdate.com/thumbs/a/e/2/ae2f4b2907a74ba4e52ab1466d06397b0e913cea.jpg

6 insights about school innovation from 173 schools you may never have heard of

There’s no shortage of opinions and ideas about how nontraditional practices are taking off in K-12 schools, but often scant data to back up those ideas—let alone data that can surface patterns and blind spots where we may not be paying attention.

The Christensen Institute

Check out the full edition! Picked For You:

https://www.edtechupdate.com/thumbs/f/4/f/f4f5126675d303dcff85e042f6a805039f4eb976.jpg

Robert Kaplinsky, Open Middle Math pioneer, talks about effective math teaching From the Cool Cat Teacher Blog by Vicki Davis Follow @coolcatteacher on Twitter Filled with dread, some math teachers have a problem. As they give problems to students to work their students become problems. Behavior problems. Boredom problems.

The CoolCatTeacher

https://www.edtechupdate.com/thumbs/7/6/e/76e5b4fd9b76e65ec0c59c6d048dc3edfefce71c.jpg

So, Apparently, There are No Verbs Without Nouns

As I mentioned in my previous post , I finally have the opportunity to help shape an entire district toward More Verbs, Fewer Nouns. We were, with the Superintendent’s direction and blessing, going from a previous Tech Director who focused on techie things (Nouns) to my becoming Tech Director focused on learning and teaching (Verbs).

More Verbs

https://www.edtechupdate.com/thumbs/9/9/2/99266a10c3363018bff5fc30c5cce8958692b7c9.jpg

3 Great Resources To Close The Adult Literacy Gap

Adult education providers encounter a variety of challenges related to closing digital literacy gaps. In the U.S., an estimated 36 million adults struggle with basic math, language, and digital literacy skills needed to find well-paying jobs and navigate public and social systems.

Digital Promise

Why Education Entrepreneurs Need To Move With Education—Not Disrupt It

Edtech investments reached an incredibly high number in 2018, with $1.45 billion raised—the same amount that hit the market in 2015. However, raising venture capital, regardless of the industry, is not a guaranteed measure of success in any business.

EdNews Daily

https://www.edtechupdate.com/thumbs/6/e/f/6efbb3baa52d97b17b6e824634891fbf1d2760d7.jpg

Keeping parents in the loop with edtech

source.subject: Follow-up to Connect install
source.body:
Mr. Louis,

We have seen the Symantec antivirus false-positive flag our installer.
To get around this,

1) Copy the installer from the flash drive to the desktop.

2) Run the installer. If the installer disappears/fails to run then:

3) Open up the Symantec control panel

4) Go to the blacklist/whitelist/quarantine section

5) Select the installer and allow/whitelist/restore the installer in the
list.

6) Run the installer again from where you copied it onto the desktop.

That should be it!

--
Michael A. Leonetti
As warm as green tea

source.subject: Your Sonarcloud device (Tilden Avenue PA System) is down - Troubleshooting
source.body:
Hello!

We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (Tilden Avenue PA System) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.

Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't send announcements either.

If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.

If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.

Thank you and have a fantastic day!

Good afternoon,

Sincerely,

Warren Kaufman

Assistant Principal of Organization

101-01 Rockaway Blvd, Ozone Park, NY 11417

718-322-0538

From: Michael from Sonarcloud <mleonetti@getsonarcloud.com>
Sent: Tuesday, October 22, 2019 1:00 PM
To: wkaufman@johnadamsnyc.org
Subject: Your Sonarcloud device (John Adams PA System) is down - Troubleshooting

Hello!

We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (John Adams PA System) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.

Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't send announcements either.

If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.

If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.

Thank you and have a fantastic day!

October 2019

http://go.mavenwave.com/l/484421/2019-10-30/j9vsl/484421/76041/0385_anthos_webinar_email_0619__2_.png WEBINAR: 5 STEPS TO GETTING HYBRID-CLOUD READY WITH ANTHOS

Most enterprise companies need a hybrid-cloud strategy in place to effectively manage their infrastructure. Enter Google’s Anthos, which enables you to build, deploy and manage hybrid applications across multiple environments.

But before you can take full advantage of Anthos, you need to take the proper steps to ensure all of the pieces are in place for it to run effectively. Join us for a webinar on November 21 at 1:00 pm EST to learn how to get hybrid-cloud ready with Anthos. Register now.

NEWS: MAVEN WAVE JOINS AS GOOGLE MANAGED SERVICES PROVIDER http://go.mavenwave.com/l/484421/2019-10-21/hxbzs/484421/74815/MSP.jpg

Maven Wave has joined the Managed Services Provider (MSP) Initiative in the Google Cloud Partner Advantage Program. This proves our expertise and ability to manage GCP support and operations for some of the world’s biggest enterprises.

It also shows our success with deep cloud solution development and delivery. Read the news item to learn more.

EBOOK: TOP 5 BARRIERS TO BUILDING A MODERN DATA PLATFORM http://go.mavenwave.com/l/484421/2019-10-21/hxczn/484421/74821/barriers.jpg

Whether you’re planning a migration to the cloud to save money or to introduce new capabilities, your modern data platform needs to be built on a solid foundation.

But some roadblocks can stand in the way of planning a migration or even identifying the right solution. Learn how to overcome these possible barriers by downloading our eBook.

WHITE PAPER: A GUIDE TO GOOGLE BIGQUERY INNER WORKINGS http://go.mavenwave.com/l/484421/2019-10-21/hxdd8/484421/74843/BigQuery.jpg

Traditional databases that tie compute and storage together can be expensive and inefficient. In cloud native databases, compute scales separately from data storage.

Google BigQuery takes advantage of fast networks in the cloud and the nearly unlimited storage available. Read our white paper to dive into the inner workings of BigQuery.

WEBINAR: FINANCIAL SERVICES UNLOCKING COMPETITIVE ADVANTAGE IN FS USING DATA http://go.mavenwave.com/l/484421/2019-10-21/hxdy8/484421/74893/fs_webinar.jpg

Whether you serve the individual consumer or the enterprise, the key to differentiation in the financial services industry lies in analyzing your data to better serve your customers.

To be able to run effective analytics, your data needs to be accessible in a central location. Watch the recording of our webinar to learn more.

WHITE PAPER: HEALTHCARE
4 WAYS TECHNOLOGY ENHANCES THE PATIENT EXPERIENCE http://go.mavenwave.com/l/484421/2019-10-25/j8xzn/484421/75687/tablet.jpg

Healthcare providers are using innovative technologies such as apps, chatbots, smart speakers, and indoor maps at every stage from prevention to post-care. As a result, they are able to provide more personalized care.

Download our eBook to learn four ways you can implement technology to enhance the patient experience at your organization.

AWARDS: FASTEST GROWING FIRM & BEST MEDIUM WORKPLACE http://go.mavenwave.com/l/484421/2019-10-29/j9jgv/484421/75901/awards.jpg

Consulting Magazine has named Maven Wave as #12 on its 2019 list of Fastest Growing Firms. This is our fifth consecutive year being included on this list.

Additionally, Maven Wave has been recognized by Great Places to Work and FORTUNE as one of the 100 Best Medium Workplaces in the United States.

source.subject: Your Sonarcloud device (Girls) is down - Troubleshooting
source.body:
Hello!

We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (Girls) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.

Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't send announcements either.

If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.

If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.

Thank you and have a fantastic day!
