source.body:
Hello!

We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (Walton Avenue PA System) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.

Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't send announcements either.

If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.

If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.

Thank you and have a fantastic day!

source.subject: Your Sonarcloud device (Woodland PA System) is down - Troubleshooting
source.body:
Hello!

We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (Woodland PA System) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.

Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't send announcements either.

If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.

If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.

Thank you and have a fantastic day!

source.subject: Important - Sonarcloud issues in DOE schools
source.body:
Hello Nelida,

As of this morning, there seem to be sporadic issues accessing our services for a good deal of DOE schools. This can show up as any of the following:

  • Cannot log into the Sonarcloud App or Dashboard (dashboard.getsonarcloud.com)
  • The Sonarcloud App hangs when sending announcements 
  • Sent announcements are not playing over the PA system
  • The Sonarcloud announcement phone will not make announcements

It seems like these issues are isolated only to DOE schools who are using Sonarcloud.

If you have noticed any of these issues, please submit a ticket to DIIT/DOE about the Sonarcloud service not working. You may forward them a link to this spec sheet which has all of the information necessary about allowing Sonarcloud to work over a network:

https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/sonarcloud-public/Documents/Spec+Sheet.pdf

Also, we can make ourselves available to anybody in any tech department who would like to contact us about this issue to inquire more. Either respond to this e-mail, e-mail support@getsonarcloud.com (best and quickest), or contact me directly at 718-407-0664, Ext. 100.

Let's work together to this fixed as soon as possible!

Thank you so much and have a great day!
​

source.subject: Your Sonarcloud device (Reece School VoIP) is down - Troubleshooting
source.body:
Hello!

We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (Reece School VoIP) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.

Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't send announcements either.

If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.

If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.

Thank you and have a fantastic day!

source.subject: Your Sonarcloud device (PS 30) is down - Troubleshooting
source.body:
Hello!

We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (PS 30) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.

Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't send announcements either.

If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.

If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.

Thank you and have a fantastic day!

source.subject: Important - issues with DOE schools and Sonarcloud - FIXED!
source.body:
Good morning Parris,

As of early last week, there seem to be sporadic issues accessing our services for a good deal of DOE schools. They appears as any of the following:

  • Cannot log into the Sonarcloud App or Dashboard (dashboard.getsonarcloud.com)
  • The Sonarcloud App hangs when sending announcements 
  • Sent announcements are not playing over the PA system
  • The Sonarcloud announcement phone will not make announcements

It turns out that DIIT/DOE is slowly migrating over all DOE schools to a new firewall. In the process, one of the firewalls had mistakenly blocked our main server address (maestro.s0nr.co).

We are happy to report that because of your diligent efforts in contacting DIIT and putting in trouble tickets the issue is now solved! Late in the school day yesterday the block had been removed. We immediately saw all offline Sonarcloud devices come back up. Also, nearly immediately, schools messaged us saying all is well. This was music to our ears!
​

We want to thank you for being a valuable part of the Sonarcloud family. We could not have done it without you.

Thank you again and have a FANTASTIC day!
​

source.subject: Important - Sonarcloud issues in DOE schools
source.body:
Hello Laura,

As of this morning, there seem to be sporadic issues accessing our services for a good deal of DOE schools. This can show up as any of the following:

  • Cannot log into the Sonarcloud App or Dashboard (dashboard.getsonarcloud.com)
  • The Sonarcloud App hangs when sending announcements 
  • Sent announcements are not playing over the PA system
  • The Sonarcloud announcement phone will not make announcements

It seems like these issues are isolated only to DOE schools who are using Sonarcloud.

If you have noticed any of these issues, please submit a ticket to DIIT/DOE about the Sonarcloud service not working. You may forward them a link to this spec sheet which has all of the information necessary about allowing Sonarcloud to work over a network:

https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/sonarcloud-public/Documents/Spec+Sheet.pdf

Also, we can make ourselves available to anybody in any tech department who would like to contact us about this issue to inquire more. Either respond to this e-mail, e-mail support@getsonarcloud.com (best and quickest), or contact me directly at 718-407-0664, Ext. 100.

Let's work together to this fixed as soon as possible!

Thank you so much and have a great day!
​

source.subject: Your Sonarcloud device (PS 356 PA System) is down - Troubleshooting
source.body:
Hello!

We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (PS 356 PA System) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.

Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't send announcements either.

If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.

If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.

Thank you and have a fantastic day!
Good morning. I’d like to have two staff members added to announcements. Dawn Saka -dsaka@ms-ap.org and Madalupe Awe - mawe@ms-ap.org. Thank you.

Hello!

We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (PS 251 Receiver) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.

Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't send announcements either.

If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.

If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.

Thank you and have a fantastic day!

source.body:

We are now into the new school year 2018-2019. Very exciting!

In order to sync your student roster data with Sonarcloud we need permissions from the DOE to do so. Thank you and have a fantastic day!

source.subject: Your Sonarcloud device (HCHS PA System) is down - Troubleshooting
source.body:
Hello!

We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (HCHS PA System) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.

Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't send announcements either.

If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.

If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.

Thank you and have a fantastic day!

source.subject: Sonarcloud - Student roster syncing for 2018/2019
source.body:
Hello!

We are now into the new school year 2018-2019. Very exciting!

In order to sync your student roster data with Sonarcloud we need permissions from the DOE to do so. We have sent ahead of this e-mail a document that is signable online from Pandadoc to your e-mail address. If you want to use the Sonarcloud sync with ATS this year please see follow the steps below:

1) Locate the e-mail from Pandadoc
2) Sign the document electronically, filling out your school and date as well.
3) Once complete, you will receive another e-mail from Pandadoc with a copy of the signed document.
4) Take that signed document, save it.
5) E-mail that signed document to ITDataRequest@schools.nyc.gov with the subject line: Sonarcloud via Clever [YOUR SCHOOL NAME].

That's it! Syncing will then automatically work for the new year without any action from you.

If you are not using Sonarcloud Reach this year or you have received this message in error, please just shoot a quick reply letting us know.

Thank you and have a fantastic day!
​

source.subject: Your Sonarcloud device (CTEA PA System) is down - Troubleshooting
source.body:
Hello!

We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device (CTEA PA System) is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.

Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't send announcements either.

If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.

If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.

Thank you and have a fantastic day!

source.subject: New safety feature: Continuous announcement replay - Sonarcloud
source.body:
Hi Janet,

Here at Sonarcloud safety is extremely important. We want to ensure that Sonarcloud is making schools and students more safe with ever new feature that we release. We've recently received a bunch of brilliant new requests that would help schools in the case of an emergency.

As always, please know that we appreciate all of your feedback. Your feedback helps not just your school, but other schools currently using Sonarcloud, and all those schools who will be using it in the future. Also, we want you to know that we do listen.

We are happy to announce that the first in a line of features to be released is the new "Continuous announcement replay" feature." This feature automatically replays an announcement repeatedly, as many times as you specify.

To use this new feature, simply on iOS, Android, or the Dashboard select the Replay button (the little icon that looks like a refresh on the recording). You will see a popup asking you how many times to repeat the announcement. Use the slider to select the number of times. Slide the slider all of the way to the right to make the announcement repeat forever. Click the play button on the bottom and your announcement will replay as specified.

Continuously repeating announcements can always be stopped manually on the Apps and Dashboard. Also, the delay between repeating announcements can be changed your Sonarcloud device settings.

Thank you again for helping to making schools safer. There will be more enhancements to come in the upcoming weeks.

Have a fantastic day!
​

source.subject: Your Sonarcloud device is down - Troubleshooting
source.body:
Hello!

We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.

Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't send announcements either.

If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.

If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.

Thank you and have a fantastic day!

source.subject: New safety feature: Continuous announcement replay - Sonarcloud
source.body:
Hi Elba,

Here at Sonarcloud safety is extremely important. We want to ensure that Sonarcloud is making schools and students more safe with ever new feature that we release. We've recently received a bunch of brilliant new requests that would help schools in the case of an emergency.

As always, please know that we appreciate all of your feedback. Your feedback helps not just your school, but other schools currently using Sonarcloud, and all those schools who will be using it in the future. Also, we want you to know that we do listen.

We are happy to announce that the first in a line of features to be released is the new "Continuous announcement replay" feature." This feature automatically replays an announcement repeatedly, as many times as you specify.

To use this new feature, simply on iOS, Android, or the Dashboard select the Replay button (the little icon that looks like a refresh on the recording). You will see a popup asking you how many times to repeat the announcement. Use the slider to select the number of times. Slide the slider all of the way to the right to make the announcement repeat forever. Click the play button on the bottom and your announcement will replay as specified.

Continuously repeating announcements can always be stopped manually on the Apps and Dashboard. Also, the delay between repeating announcements can be changed your Sonarcloud device settings.

Thank you again for helping to making schools safer. There will be more enhancements to come in the upcoming weeks.

Have a fantastic day!

source.subject: Your Sonarcloud device is back UP!
source.body:
Hello

It looks like your Sonarcloud device has come back up. Yay!

Announcements that you make through your apps will now go out as expected. You do not need to take any further action towards fixing your device.

If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to us at any time.

Have a fantastic day!

Hello!

We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.

Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't send announcements either.

If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.

If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.

Thank you and have a fantastic day!

source.subject: New safety feature: Continuous announcement replay - Sonarcloud
source.body:
Hi Renee,

Here at Sonarcloud safety is extremely important. We want to ensure that Sonarcloud is making schools and students more safe with ever new feature that we release. We've recently received a bunch of brilliant new requests that would help schools in the case of an emergency.

As always, please know that we appreciate all of your feedback. Your feedback helps not just your school, but other schools currently using Sonarcloud, and all those schools who will be using it in the future. Also, we want you to know that we do listen.

We are happy to announce that the first in a line of features to be released is the new "Continuous announcement replay" feature." This feature automatically replays an announcement repeatedly, as many times as you specify.

To use this new feature, simply on iOS, Android, or the Dashboard select the Replay button (the little icon that looks like a refresh on the recording). You will see a popup asking you how many times to repeat the announcement. Use the slider to select the number of times. Slide the slider all of the way to the right to make the announcement repeat forever. Click the play button on the bottom and your announcement will replay as specified.

Continuously repeating announcements can always be stopped manually on the Apps and Dashboard. Also, the delay between repeating announcements can be changed your Sonarcloud device settings.

Thank you again for helping to making schools safer. There will be more enhancements to come in the upcoming weeks.

Have a fantastic day!
​

source.subject: Your Sonarcloud device is down - Troubleshooting
source.body:
Hello!

We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.

Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't send announcements either.

If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.

If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.

Thank you and have a fantastic day!

source.subject: Your Sonarcloud device down - Troubleshooting
source.body:
Hello!

We are getting alerts that your Sonarcloud device is down. Please note that while the Sonarcloud device is down you will not be able to make announcements through the device. I'd like to take a moment to go through with you some troubleshooting steps to try and get the device back up and running so that you can make announcements.

Firstly, let's check if there is Internet and power in your building. Please check the computers to make sure that you are able to get online and that the lights are working in the building. If either of these aren't working, unfortunately, currently, Sonarcloud won't send announcements either.

If both of those things work, please try rebooting your Sonarcloud device. This device is a little device with our Sonarcloud logo on it. This device will be plugged into the power (AC outlet) of your building. Please locate the small power cable (which almost looks like an Android cell phone charger). Next, unplug it from the wall and plug it back in. The Sonarcloud device should come up within a minute. Your App and dashboard should alert you when this happens. We will also be able to see it.

If this doesn't work, please reach out to us and we can troubleshoot further.

Thank you and have a fantastic day!

source.subject: Sonarcloud device still down this morning.
source.body:
Good morning Mr. Lev,

It seems that the Sonarcloud device is still down this morning. Oftentimes in this case the Device is accidentally unplugged from either power or internet.

Near the left corner of the room we have installed a Network switch. This provides internet for the computers in the room and for the Sonarcloud device. This could have been accidentally unplugged.

Or, on the floor near the desks, the extension cord that provides power could have been unplugged. Plugging in these devices would likely fix the issue.

If that doesn’t work, you could try to unplug and plug in the power for the Sonarcloud device to restart it.

Let me know if you need help on any of this or nothing seems to be working.

Thank you and have a great day!

source.subject: Sonarcloud for free
source.body:
Hi Mr.Chambers,

You were previously a user of Sonarcloud, our messaging app that answers the needs for school communication and safety everywhere. We’ve relaunched and improved Sonarcloud and in this process, you accidentally got dropped from the system and never found your way back 😕  .That makes me sad, so as the founder I wanted to reach out and fix that! 

Basically we took Sonarcloud and made it bigger and better and awesomer (is that even a word?!). We now have the ability to talk from any computer and also message parents in groups or classes, translate to any language in realtime. We would love for you to try the new Sonarcloud free for the rest of the year and get your valuable feedback.

If you have any questions, feedback, or need any help please don’t hesitate to email me, or give me a call at 3476108367.  Could we stop in next week sometime to demo the new features – did I mention it’s awesome? 

Thanks,

Jesse / Sonarcloud

P.S. Happy new year. I can still say that, right?

source.subject: Replay recordings feature
source.body:
Hello Mr. Woltmann,

Long time no speak! Hoping that all is well.
​

My apologies for being late on this topic. The feature you requested got push back a few more versions. However we are happy to announce version 1.08 of the iOS App of SonarCloud supports announcement replaying!

Now, announcements can be found easily by when they were made and who made them, as well as by how long they were. By tapping on the little circle arrow that you see on the right, the announcement can be replayed immediately.
​

There are also new features like being able to stop a recording already playing, text to speech announcements, and translations to different languages.

Thank you for all of your suggestions and help!

--
Michael A. Leonetti
As warm as green tea
